gloss: person in charge; attendant; clerk; staff member

definitions.gloss: person in charge; attendant; clerk; staff member
definitions.explanation: Refers to a person responsible for or assigned to a particular task or area, often seen in public facilities, transportation, and customer service contexts.

examples.japanese: {係員|かかりいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{係員|かかりいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{案内|あんない}して→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
{入口|いりぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{係員|かかりいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}している→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: An attendant is checking tickets at the entrance.

examples.japanese: お⟦{困|こま}り→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{係員|かかりいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{声|こえ}がけ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you need help, please speak to a nearby staff member.

notes:
Refers to a worker or staff member responsible for a specific duty or area. Unlike ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧, which emphasizes being in charge of a specific case or project, {係員|かかりいん} emphasizes the role of attending to tasks at a particular post or station, typically in public-facing service positions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {係員|かかりいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尋|たず}ねる→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧: to ask a staff member
- {係員|かかりいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the attendant's instructions
- {係員|かかりいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call a staff member

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge — focuses on responsibility for a specific matter or case
- ⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: employee/staff — broader term for institutional employees
- ⟦{係|かかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧: charge/duty — can refer to the role itself or the person informally
